If relevant, trace issues into risk assessment, treatment and review. If not relevant, retain support for that conclusion and reconsider on material change. Test both decision branches without inventing actual site hazards or a required third site.
resolved_analysis: Amendment text was read from the pinned original, PDF page 5; the requirement and explanatory note have distinct treatment.
remaining_dependency: Actual context, interested-party requirements and management's reasoned relevance determination.
